name: NodeMCU ESP8266
fullName: NodeMCU ESP8266 Wi-Fi CP2102 / CH340 Development Board
tagline: Open-source IoT development board with integrated Wi-Fi and breadboard headers
description: NodeMCU is an open-source firmware and development kit that helps you to prototype your IoT products with Lua or Arduino C++. Built on the ESP-12E module, it exposes full GPIOs, SPI, UART, I2C, and analog ADC pins with onboard 3.3V voltage regulator and USB-to-UART bridge.
wiringNote: Do not connect 5V logic signals directly to NodeMCU GPIOs (use level shifters or voltage dividers).
libraryName: ESP8266 Board Core for Arduino IDE
commonMistakes: Placing module on metal breadboard surfaces causing shorts
